comments.author: DeadLeaves
comments.body_html:
The //<name> is just a comment: it does nothing. the long string of random letters and numbers is the ID of the weapon. You can find the ID of a weapon on https://db.sp-tarkov.com/

and then looking at the 3rd line from the top named _id

“_id”:“5cadfbf7ae92152ac412eeef” You want to copy that string into the list of weapons. Remember to keep the quotation marks. Also make sure to have a comma after each new weapon EXCEPT the last one.

Example below

“5fb64bc92b1b027b1f50bcf2”, <— COMMA “5fc3f2d5900b1d5091531e57”, <— COMMA “5cc82d76e24e8d00134b4b83”, <— COMMA “5bd70322209c4d00d7167b8f” <— NO COMMA
